name: project-progress
description: A progress bar per session: a cheap model estimates how far the project is, paused while you are away, when the bar shows the context left instead.

idleMinutes.title: Away after (minutes)
idleMinutes.description: Minutes without mouse or keyboard input before estimates pause and the bar shows the context left.

intervalSeconds.title: Check every (seconds)
intervalSeconds.description: How often the session is checked; the model is asked only when something changed.

model.title: Estimator model
model.description: The model that estimates progress: an alias or a full model id.

renameTitles.title: Bar in the session title
renameTitles.description: Put a short emoji bar at the start of the session's title, so the sidebar shows it.

dailyTokenCap.title: Daily token cap per session
dailyTokenCap.description: Estimates stop for the day once the estimator has used this many tokens in one session.

hideDoneAfterMinutes.title: Hide finished projects after (minutes)
hideDoneAfterMinutes.description: Minutes after a finished project was seen before the projects pane and window leave it out.
